Ask the user to fill in a form from a host tool

Source: R/host_ask_form.R
codeagent_ask_form.Rd

Shows a form in the chat's interaction card (the one AskUserForm uses) and waits for the user. Call it from a host tool passed to codeagent_server() and return (a promise of) the tool's result from its answer. Forms queue with the session's other questions and approvals.

Usage

codeagent_ask_form(
  title,
  fields,
  submit_label = "Submit",
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

title

Character(1). Heading of the form.

fields

A list of fields, each a list with name, label, type ("text", "textarea", "number", "select", "multiselect", "checkbox", "date", "grouping"), and optionally choices, default, required and help – the AskUserForm field spec. A grouping field takes choices (e.g. treatment arms) and an optional default such as "Mono: a, b; Combo: c"; its value is list(group = choices).

submit_label

Character(1). Label of the submit button.

session

The Shiny session running codeagent_server(); defaults to the current one.

Value

A promise of list(submitted = TRUE/FALSE, values = list(name = value)); values is empty when the user cancelled. Without a session running codeagent_server() the form is answered from getOption("codeagent.test_form_answer") (tests), on the console when interactive, or cancelled – and the list is returned directly.

See also

codeagent_server(), ask_user_form_tool()
